definitions.strength_freeze: all strength groups use only Theme Momentum Day0 fields
definitions.RS63_TOP3: top three 63-day returns inside the Day0 theme
definitions.RS63_TOP1: top one 63-day return inside the Day0 theme
definitions.DUAL_TOP3: top three on both 63-day and 189-day returns
definitions.DUAL_TOP2: top two on both 63-day and 189-day returns
definitions.DUAL_TOP1: top one on both 63-day and 189-day returns
definitions.DUAL_OUTPERFORM: DUAL_TOP3 and both 63-day/189-day return above SPY on Day0
definitions.TOUCH: first RSI14 observation at or below threshold within 20 sessions of Day0
definitions.RISE: first RSI14 up-day after TOUCH, still searched inside the same 20-session window
definitions.entry: signal known at close; buy next open; 5 bps per side

limitations: Nested strength groups and six thresholds create multiple comparisons; require discovery/confirmation agreement and clustered intervals.
Yahoo adjusted OHLCV may differ from TradingView.
